title: Colca Canyon Express
description: Admire one of the deepest canyons in the world and watch condors flying free. End the trip relaxing in the La Calera hot springs, with waters at 38°C with views of the volcanoes.

itinerary.title: Arequipa → Colca Canyon
itinerary.description: Departure at 3:00 am from Arequipa. Stop at the viewpoint of the Misti and Chachani volcanoes. Arrival at Cruz del Cóndor to watch the flight of the condors. Lunch in Chivay. Free afternoon to explore the town.

itinerary.title: Chivay → Hot Springs → Arequipa
itinerary.description: Free morning to visit the Chivay market. Transfer to the La Calera hot springs to relax for 2 hours. Return to Arequipa arriving at approximately 6:00 pm.

includes: 1 night in a hotel in Chivay
